svg.text: Actual Budget: checkpoint the sync log without losing offline edits
Every budget change is an encrypted CRDT message that the sync server keeps forever. The agent adds checkpoints: a device uploads a compact snapshot, and the
server drops the messages it covers while the sync group stays the same.
snapshot body plus base, checkpoint id and merkle headers; 200 only
if the base and prior checkpoint still match, else 409; 400 on a bad
adds checkpointId (field 7) to the request and checkpointWanted,
checkpointRequired, checkpointBase (3, 4, 6) to the response; asks
unchanged routes that must keep working
TypeScript in /app, edited by the agent
encrypted budget file, replaced by the snapshot
CRDT message log; a commit deletes exactly the
file info: group id, checkpoint id
starts the real server and real devices, then forces the hard timings
goes offline, makes 8 edits that are not sent
200: log pruned to N, file replaced, group G kept
rejoin: sync with the old checkpoint id
After two syncs all three devices hold the 30 online edits and the 8 offline ones, in group G, with at most one log message per cell.
a device that was offline during the checkpoint rejoins without losing its edits (test threshold: 3 messages)
